node.statement: By nodes 1.1.1 and 1.1.2, p is stationary for F, S is nonempty with i in S, S is closed, and G is row-stochastic. By the definition S={a:p_a>0}, p is zero off S and p_S is strictly positive; for every b in S, (p_S G)_b=sum_{a in S}p_a f_ab=sum_{a=1}^n p_a f_ab=(pF)_b=p_b, so p_S is a stationary probability for G. Therefore node 1.1.3 applies and every positive-entry edge of G has both endpoints in the same strongly connected component.
